tenant_boundary: per-account session isolation; no cross-tenant data access; tenant-scoped rate limits and quotas
deployment_topology: gateway isolates tenants; no direct client-to-target path
gateway has no inbound control-plane exposure beyond the authenticated proxy

ssrf.threat: a tenant abuses the gateway to reach internal metadata endpoints
controls: private-range targets default-deny unless explicitly allowed

internal_access.threat: the gateway is used to pivot into the internal network

controls: credentials never stored on the gateway
content-free audit of sessions and transfers
no secret values in audit logs

abuse.threat: the gateway is used for scanning or spam
